import { type PropertyValues } from 'lit';
import * as tabs from '@zag-js/tabs';
import type { Machine } from '@zag-js/core';
type TabsSchema = tabs.Machine extends Machine<infer T> ? T : never;
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
import { ZagController } from '../../controllers/zag-controller.js';
export interface TabItem {
    value: string;
    label: unknown;
    content: unknown;
    disabled?: boolean;
    id?: string;
}
export declare class Tabs extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        value: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        defaultValue: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        activationMode: {
            attribute: string;
        };
        orientation: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    items: readonly TabItem[];
    value: string | undefined;
    defaultValue: string | undefined;
    activationMode: 'manual' | 'automatic';
    orientation: 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
    private state;
    readonly machine: ZagController<TabsSchema, ReturnType<typeof tabs.connect>>;
    private pointerFocus?;
    private pointerDown;
    constructor();
    get selectedValue(): string;
    protected willUpdate(_changed: PropertyValues): void;
    private request;
    private key;
    updated(): void;
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
export {};
